root_idea.summary: The root develops along two principal lines: cleaving or stripping away a surface, and excessive desire or greed.
root_idea.development: The physical idea of scraping or stripping explains usages for torn cloth, lacerations, rain that strips the ground, and exhausted pasture; a separate semantic line denotes vehement or excessive desire, with related senses of striving and solicitude.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form حَرَصَ.
Displayed as the Quran-attested elative adjective أَحْرَصُ.
Displayed as the Quran-attested adjective حَرِيصٌ.

senses.definition: To desire intensely; to be exceedingly eager for an object or outcome.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic uses express vehement or excessive desire, including constructions with عَلَى and بِ directed toward a desired outcome or person.

senses.definition: More or most intensely desirous; in the Quranic comparison, the most greedy or covetous for life.
senses.usage_conditions: An elative comparative or superlative construction with عَلَى; the supplied Quranic occurrence describes being most desirous of life.

senses.definition: Deeply solicitous for someone's benefit; intensely eager to benefit them, and therefore compassionate and caring toward them.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression حَرِيصٌ عَلَيْكُمْ, the person marked by عَلَى is the object of this benevolent concern; the usage allows both eagerness to benefit and excessive solicitude or compassion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tear or cleave something, or to strip, scrape, rub, or abrade away its superficial part; of pasture, to become wholly consumed as though stripped from the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the physical branch of the root and includes removal of a surface by force or repeated action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rent or abrasion in a garment or piece of cloth, including cloth damaged through beating, washing, or whitening.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The two headwords are attested for the resulting tear or damaged cloth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To desire an object culpably, excessively, or greedily, especially worldly goods.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the morally censurable or worldly specialization of intense desire, distinct from the neutral Quranic contexts represented above.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strive, labor, exert oneself, or take pains to acquire, obtain, or attain an object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction may denote effort directed toward attaining the object, not merely desire for it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be excessively solicitous, careful, or fearful regarding a person, and to be very pitiful or compassionate toward that person.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a person-directed construction and is distinct from desire for an impersonal object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To apply oneself constantly or perseveringly to a matter or affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III presents sustained, repeated application to the matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: How vehemently, excessively, or culpably desirous, greedy, or covetous you are of something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An exclamative construction, especially used of excessive desire for worldly goods.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To watch for or await eagerly the time of an anticipated thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The attested construction concerns watching for the time of a meal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehement or excessive desire, eagerness, avidity, greed, or covetousness for a sought object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun can carry a censurable sense of inordinate desire, particularly for worldly good.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strenuous effort or exertion undertaken to acquire, obtain, or attain something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the noun of directed striving rather than desire alone.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Excessive solicitude, care, or fear for a person, together with excessive pity or compassion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A person-directed extension of the noun's desire-related meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Vehemently desirous, eager, greedy, hankering, or covetous.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This general adjective meaning is broader than the benevolent, person-directed Quranic usage represented under the public form حَرِيصٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A slight wound of the head that cleaves the skin; the first degree among head wounds.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An anatomical technical usage for a superficial laceration.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rain cloud whose vehemently falling rain strips the surface of the ground.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The defining feature is the force of the rain and its effect in removing the ground's surface.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Much lacerated by the bites of other asses.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive participial description of an animal bearing extensive bite-lacerations.
A passive participial description of land heavily consumed by grazing and trampling.
